newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Arthuis fully confident in German deficit plans.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis fully confident in German deficit plans.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday he had full confidence in Germany's ability to bring its total deficit below 3.0 percent of GDP this year.
He told a news conference he had held several hours of talks with German Finance Minister Theo Waigel in Lyon, France, last week.
"I had confirmation of the determination and the ability of the German authorities to respect the target," he said.
He noted that Germany aimed to bring its deficit below 3.0 percent of gross domestic product this year.
"I have full confidence in that," he said.
He alkso reiterated that there was strong convergence between the French and German economies ahead of the launch of European monetary union in 1999.
"We will therefore be there on January 1, 1999," he said.
